neighbours.label: Republic / republican and American as words of national-political identity ('the Republic of Ireland', 'because he was American')
fire: The rebels proclaimed the Republic of Ireland in 1916.
He struggled to find work in London because he was American.
The republican government abolished the monarchy after the war.
Formal recognition of the republic came several years later.
Many of the settlers were American by birth and English by descent.
She was born in Cork, in the Republic, and moved to Boston.
The colonists fought to found an independent republic of their own.
His accent made it obvious to everyone that he was American.
quiet: The rebels proclaimed the Kingdom of Ireland in 1916.
He struggled to find work in London because he was young.
The military government abolished the monarchy after the war.
Formal recognition of the treaty came several years later.
Many of the settlers were farmers by trade and English by descent.
She was born in Cork, in the south, and moved to Boston.
The colonists fought to found an independent church of their own.
His accent made it obvious to everyone that he was nervous.
